meta.name: creating-dbt-models
meta.description:
Creates dbt models following project conventions. Use when working with dbt models for:
(1) Creating new models (any layer - discovers project's naming conventions first)
(2) Task mentions "create", "build", "add", "write", "new", or "implement" with model, table, or SQL
(3) Modifying existing model logic, columns, joins, or transformations
(4) Implementing a model from schema.yml specs or expected output requirements
Discovers project conventions before writing. Runs dbt build (not just compile) to verify.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照项目规范创建或修改 dbt 模型。它会先了解项目命名规则，然后编写 SQL，最后运行 dbt build 验证，并检查输出数据是否正确。
howto.when: 当你要求创建、修改或实现 dbt 模型时触发，例如提到“创建”、“构建”、“添加”、“写入”、“新”或“实现”等词，并涉及模型、表或 SQL。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 dbt 模型，包含客户总消费金额。
say.note: Claude 会先查看项目规范，然后编写模型并验证。

say.text: 修改现有模型，增加一个计算字段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates or modifies dbt models following project conventions. It first discovers naming rules, writes SQL, then runs dbt build to verify, and checks output data for correctness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create, modify, or implement a dbt model, e.g., mentioning "create", "build", "add", "write", "new", or "implement" with model, table, or SQL.

say_en.text: Create a new dbt model with total customer spend.
say_en.note: Claude will discover conventions, write the model, and verify.

say_en.text: Modify an existing model to add a calculated field.
say_en.note: Claude will update logic and run dbt build to verify.
